bulletins.spokenText: James Street's at a standstill, with Toogood Road also backed up. Unleaded's cheapest at a dollar ninety-six in Edge Hill, with diesel at two thirty-five there too. Roadworks and changed traffic conditions are updated weekly on the Cairns Regional Council website. Download the iHeartRadio app to take us anywhere — search Star Cairns.
